records.title: PMMSY in Uttar Pradesh
details: (a) to (c): It was inter-alia stated taht further, the Department of Fisheries, during last four years (2020-21 to 2023-24) and current financial year 2024-25 has accorded approval to the fisheries development proposals of government of Uttar Pradesh at a total outlay of Rs.1294.33 crore involving central share of Rs.412.31 crore for development of fisheries and aquaculture activities to enhance the income of fishers and fish farmers in the State and as a result 17438 beneficiaries have been benefited. During the current Financial Year (2024-25). the Department of Fisheries, Government of India has accorded approval for various fisheries developmental activities to the tune of Rs.131.31 crore with central liability of Rs.43.72 crore and an amount of Rs.115.544 crore has been released to the Government of Uttar Pradesh and beneficiary selection is under process as reported by the Government of Uttar Pradesh.
